container: zip -> single <MODEL>_<ver>.bin (raw SPI flash image, size multiple of 64 KiB banks)
image: the .bin itself; sizes 640 KiB-2 MiB; header = banked 8051 (LJMP at 0, 8-byte vectors)
notes: Novatek/MStar/Realtek all ship this way; family from strings (RTDnnnn/NT68nnn) and DDC caps model()

container: zip -> <MODEL>_<ver>.exe (PE + appended 7z SFX) -> FWUPD/{F<ver>.bin, FA<ver>.bin, upd.xml, setup.iss, UpdFW_RTK.exe, RFlash.dll, RtHIDlib.dll, RTKCmd_x64.dll}
image: FWUPD/F*.bin (main) and FA*.bin (second image, e.g. second scaler/USB-C MCU); upd.xml has <model>,<fw>,<fw_ver>,<exe>rtk
obfuscation: none for RTD2718/19/28/98; RTD2738/2739 images are not plain 8051 (entropy 7.1, no reset vector)
notes: Updater talks to the monitor over USB HID (RtHIDlib.dll HID_i2cread/i2cwrite/readflash/writeflash/handshakeauth...), not GPU DDC

container: zip -> .exe -> 7z -> setup.exe (InstallShield/NSIS) + FWUPD/UpdPack.exe (7z SFX) -> OSDSidekick + F*.bin + UpdFW_RTK/UpdFW_Nova
notes: Nova = Novatek variant of the same updater pack; both in one package

image: .upg = Dell UPG container: big-endian length-prefixed header (UPG, 1.0.6, model, version, component list 'DISPLAY'...), per-chunk base64-url strings, then binary payload
obfuscation: payload encrypted (random-looking, per-chunk key strings in header); key logic in Firmware Updater.exe, not cracked
notes: plugins/display.dll has MStarISP and RealtekISP classes (scalar/realtek/realtek_isp.cpp), I2C channel select

container: zip -> <pkg>/{LenovoFwUpdate.exe (Rust GUI), fwconfig.ini, FW/<hub>.bin, Scaler/{fwupdate.exe, Comm.dll, Comm/*.dll, PlugIn/{Flash.dat,WinIspPlugIn.dll}, IspSetting.ini, <MODEL>_<RTDnnnn>_Multipanel_<flashaddr>_<ver>.bin}}
image: Scaler/*.bin = Realtek ISP image (RTDCustomerTool 'Reduce' image, flash address in name); FW/*.bin = RTS54xx hub/PD firmware
notes: Host side is RTDCustomerTool: Comm_{RealtekUSB,UsbHubI2C,TypeCUsb,TypeCI2C,Aux}.dll + IntelControlAPI; WinSignatureVerify.dll

container: zip -> LenovoFirmwareUpdateTool.exe + pkg/{fwconfig.ini, Monitor/{ISPTool.exe(.NET), fwconfig.ini, <model>.bin, Genesys/*.bin, Infineon/*.bin, Firmware upgrade sop.docx}}
zip -> MultiIsp vN (update tool)/{Multi-ISP.exe, GlFlash_*.fl, GL Driver Installation.exe} + 'Scaler FW'/*.bin + 'HUB FW'/*.bin (Genesys hub)
spNNNNNN.exe (7z SFX) -> HPFwUpdate.exe + GLHub.dll + RvcLib.dll + rsa_{pub,pub_isp}.txt + rsa_verify/decrypt.exe + *Service_Header.bin (scaler) + GL35xx hub .bin
image: *_Service_Header.bin (signed: RSA header; U28 = MStar, not Realtek)

container: zip -> *_Mac.pkg (xar) -> component_*.pkg/Payload (gzip cpio) -> firmwareupdater.app (Sciter, libusb, libdisplay/libdevices/libwebcam dylibs) + <ver>/<model>_<ver>_ECN*.upg
zip (ZipCrypto, per-model password string embedded in OSC macOS binary) -> images/{Scaler,PD,NXP,Hub}/*.bin + images.txt
image: images/Scaler/<MODEL>_<RTD25xx|RTD27xx|MSTAR_MST9800>_V<ver>_<crc>_rev<N>_<date>.bin (raw SPI image; chip named in filename)
obfuscation: ZipCrypto only; scaler payload plain (RTD2595LT/2583UT/2785T images match RL6449 libs)
notes: Fetch: lmu.lge.com/ExternalService/onscreencontrol/fw/<MODEL>/FWLatestVersion.txt -> same dir zip. Extract: scripts/fw_lg_unzip.py. NotAllowedPage = no fw for model.

container: zip -> {OneKeyUpdate/*.exe (7z SFX) -> Scaler/ISPTool/*.bin, Hub/RTS54xx*.bin, PD/RTS5450M*.bin, MCU/} | USBFlashDriveUpdate/<MODEL>.bin | legacy V0xx: *.bin + SOP pdf
notes: Source: rog.asus.com/support/webapi/ProductV2/GetPDBIOS?model=<slug>&m1id=<productGroupID from page JSON-LD> (only m1id needed); file host dlcdnets.asus.com/pub/ASUS/LCD Monitors/. Scalers seen: RTD2738/2739 (non-8051), Novatek, MStar; no RL6449.

container: zip -> single M-<code>-<ver>[<crc>].{bin,Bin,img} (MStar/Novatek) | Update_File.zip -> 2 bins | T-PTM*.zip = Tizen smart-monitor OS image (GB-sized, not scaler)
zip -> BenQDisplayQuickit/{BenQDisplayQuickit.exe (.NET), Lib/BenQHubInfo*.sys (VLI/Realtek hub drivers), RhHubAPI.dll} | macOS dmg
image: none bundled: scaler firmware downloaded per device (qotaapi.benq.com /api/v2/model/latestVersion, /api/external/v2/checkVerInfo; needs MAC+serial)

container: zip -> MSI Firmware Update Utility (monitor firmware tool, no images)
notes: Source: msi.com/api/v1/product/support/panel?product=<slug>&type=firmware&os=Win11 64; only 1 of 183 monitor slugs lists firmware (MAG-274QRF-QD-E2).
App catalog + firmware update tool; backend displayportalcms.pmsdsolutions.com/api, monitorcontrolportal.pmsdsolutions.com

notes: aoc.com/us product page #driversAndManuals -> /api/asset/<piId>?ext=..; no firmware category on U32G4ZMN.
